analysis.summary: Fonebox Retail Limited reported an 11% growth in Profit After Tax (PAT) for H1 FY25 compared to H1 FY24, alongside a 17% increase in revenue. The company is focusing on operational efficiency and margin improvement through negotiations with major brands like Samsung, Vivo, and Xiaomi. Management is prioritizing revenue growth over aggressive store count expansion, with a specific focus on scaling operations in Maharashtra. The company aims to achieve a revenue of 400-470 crore and a PAT of 4 crore for FY25. Fonebox Retail Limited reported a 17% increase in revenue from operations for the half-year ended September 30, 2024, compared to the previous corresponding period.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a revenue of 400-470 crore and a PAT of 4 crore for FY25.
guidance.quote: Our revenue target is 400 plus at least. If we calculate with tax it will nearly around so it is without tax. We are seeing on the balance sheet part on the Tax. With the tax it will lead around 464-470 crore.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observes that physical retail sales have been increasing over the last six quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: But since last 6 quarter, if we see the data physical retail is being increasing every day.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to maintain a store mix of 70% FOCO and 30% COCO models.
capex_expansion.quote: The count should be 70-30 and the revenue should be 50-50.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully negotiated improved margins with Samsung, Vivo, and Xiaomi.
margins_costs.quote: I'm seeing on the some of the brands like Samsung, Vivo and Xiaomi. We are successful this year to increment our margin

margins_costs.claim: The company aims to improve profitability by reducing expenditures and increasing marketing efforts.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company looks forward to strengthen its operations by curtailing expenditure, aggressive domestic marketing etc. This would further help the Company to improve its results and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company had 185 active stores as of November 15, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes interest-free advance capital from NBFCs like Bajaj Finance for inventory management.
capital_allocation.quote: For example. there is a Bajaj finance, they give us one crore rupees in advance. We need to reimburse those money by selling phones on the Bajaj finance, which will cost us on 0 interest.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board did not recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25 to conserve resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve the resources for future prospect and growth of the Company, the Board of Directors of the Company have not recommended any dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended 31st March, 2025.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that online e-commerce players are under profit pressure, which has led to changes in the retail landscape.
risks_headwinds.quote: Even if it is an Amazon or Flipkart, both are under a profit pressure. Right now.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces various risks including market conditions, economic changes, and competitive dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, market conditions in the retail distribution sector, economic and regulatory changes, competitive dynamics, the Company's ability to implement its strategies effectively, and fluctuations in customer demand.

management_commitments.claim: The company appointed M/s. G K Kotecha & Associates as Secretarial Auditor for a five-year term.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company, at its Meeting held on May, 21 2025, based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee, has, after considering and evaluating various proposals and factors such as independence, industry experience, technical skills, audit team, audit quality reports, etc. recommended the appointment of M/s. G K Kotecha & Associates, a peer reviewed firm of company secretaries in practice, to conduct Secretarial Audit and issue Secretarial Audit Report for a term of five (5) consecutive years from financial year April 1, 2025 up to March 31, 2030

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
